mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT mmi.FACTORY_CODE, mmi.MATERIAL_CODE, mmi.MATERIAL_DESC, mmi.PRO_SIZE, mmi.PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE, mmi.SPECIFICATIONS, mmi.MAIN_PATTERN, mmi.PATTERN, mmi.TIRE_TYPE, mmi.COMMON_TYPE, mmi.STRUCTURE_NAME, mmi.CANT_PRODUCE, mmi.PRODUCT_CATEGORY, mmi.GROSS_RATE_JSON, mmi.FORBID_TAG FROM t_mdm_material_info mmi WHERE IFNULL(mmi.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND mmi.MATERIAL_CATEGORY = '01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_dp_demand_plan prp WHERE IFNULL(prp.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND prp.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND prp.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND prp.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND prp.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = #{monthPlanVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND mmi.MATERIAL_DESC = prp.MATERIAL_DESC AND mmi.FACTORY_CODE = prp.FACTORY_CODE)
